limitations: The full per-time contact results at all 48 action times are not retained for every simulation; the saved episode_average records and producer source establish the requested time averaging. These aggregate records independently satisfy the Frobenius identity and paired-summary checks.

Contact evaluation uses a fixed rotated orthonormal query basis rather than the literal canonical basis; the three-query average equals v0^2||D-P||_F^2/3 and therefore equals the revised definition for any measured rotation. No metric rescaling is needed.
The audit does not recompute Bingham normalizers or predictive densities; it verifies the saved normalized prequential_score and its source definition.

actual_pdf_audit.scope: Read-only Python AST and PDF inspection. No plotting code, fitting, simulation or numerical benchmark is executed. Primary text sizes are matched to actual PDF text and scaled to a six-inch insertion; math subscripts are excluded from that assessment. Page-bound text is checked; artist overlap and graphical clarity require visual review. PDF vector text and lines have no dpi.
